name: Kit Builder
notes: v1.0.1 — fix: a track playing elsewhere could still trigger Kit Builder's pads while it was merely parked (Back), not actually exited — suspend_keeps_js keeps its DSP loaded and wired to Move's internal pad-note stream the whole time. Kit Builder now mutes its own DSP the moment it's parked and unmutes on resume; parking is still instant, nothing can sound until you're looking at it again. Builds on v1.0.0's knob-grid redesign — see CHANGELOG.md for the full list.
